title: Naming Of Streets And The Control Of The Erection Of Monuments Law
long_title: A LAW TO PROVIDE FOR THE NAMING OF STREETS AND FOR THE CONTROL OF THE ERECTION OF MONUMENTS ON PUBLIC PROPERTY AND FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR INCIDENTAL THERETO.
amends_recorded_elsewhere: Municipal Councils Ordinance; Urban Councils Ordinance

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Short title.
body.raw_text: 1. This Law may be cited as the Naming of Streets and the Control of the Erection of Monuments Law, No. 4 of 1975.

body.heading: Control and erection of monuments.
body.raw_text: 7. No person shall erect a monument on any land belonging to the Republic or on any land vested in or belonging to any local authority except with the prior approval of the Minister granted upon an application made in that behalf by such person.
body.text: No person shall erect a monument on any land belonging to the Republic or on any land vested in or belonging to any local authority except with the prior approval of the Minister granted upon an application made in that behalf by such person.

body.heading: Naming of public parks, &c.
body.raw_text: 8. It shall not be lawful for any local authority to name any public parks, playground, library, reading room, stadium, building, clock tower, bridge or bathing-well except with the prior approval of the Minister.
body.text: It shall not be lawful for any local authority to name any public parks, playground, library, reading room, stadium, building, clock tower, bridge or bathing-well except with the prior approval of the Minister.

children.raw_text: "monument: includes any statue, pillar, post, or any structure erected to commemorate any person whether living or dead but does not include any structure, tomb, or cross erected in any cemetery or burial ground.
